text:
alex: heads-up — new int4 onboard (sparrow-lite) showing funcall JSON decode errors that all trace back to lone Unicode surrogate escapes in the model output (e.g. `\\uD83D` not followed by a low surrogate). parse_fail_rate jumped from 0.6% -> 7.9% after the quant bundle.

priya: any raw samples?

alex: uploaded a few to s3://canary/utf_surrogates/1739000000/ (raw bytes + hex). one sample pretty printed: ```{\"action\": \"annotate\", \"note\": \"Nice! \uD83D\"}\n``` parser fails with `Invalid \u escape` on strict decoding.

sam: interesting — this is different from truncated utf8 or trailing control chars. looks like a high-surrogate unicode escape was emitted but the low-surrogate half was never produced. could be model-level tokenization oddity or quant kernel dropping bytes during chunk flush.

ken: canary-bot metrics: failures concentrated on streaming chat with batch_size=1 and seq_len < 140. non-quant fp16 baseline stable ~0.5%. current canary: 42 successes / 5 failures in 20m.

canary-bot: deploy sparrow-lite-int4 @ 1738998000 -> hostset green. recent failure ids: cnry-1738999912, cnry-1739000111.

marta: triage plan: 1) reproduce locally with int4 runner + same tokenizer 2) capture last 64 bytes of stream output from kernel 3) check whether token boundaries align with `\\u` sequences.

priya: quick mitigation options: a) strict-parse -> on `Invalid \u` error, run repair pass that converts lone high-surrogates to U+FFFD (replacement char) before schema validation, tag telemetry `rescue=unicode_surrogate_replace`; b) retry-first: issue a narrow retry (same prompt, max_tokens=8) to let model finish the surrogate pair — cheaper but may change timing and costs.

sam: both have tradeoffs. repair (a) mutates visible user content which can change semantics; retry (b) may not finish and will consume retry budget. another idea: attempt a targeted completion RPC to ask model to finish the last token only, but that's basically a retry.

ken: telemetry-driven approach: implement two-step rescue for canary routes: 1) on Invalid \\u, attempt single retry (telemetry tag `rescue=retry_surrogate`) 2) if retry fails and failure sample shows lone high surrogate at EOF, apply conservative sanitizer that replaces lone `\\uD8xx` with `\uFFFD` (telemetry `rescue=surrogate_replace`). emit both original and repaired payload to mirror queue for auditing. only opt-in on canaries initially.

marta: long-term: quant/kernel should avoid splitting token encodings mid-escape. add kernel test for `escape-aligned-flush` in CI that fuzzes short outputs with `\\uXXXX` sequences and ensures flush boundaries don't produce half-escapes. opened QNT-918 for quant team.

priya: small repair example (PoC): ```python
# on json decode error
s = raw_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass')
# replace lone high surrogates (regex for \uD800-\uDBFF not followed by \uDC00-\uDFFF)
fixed = re.sub(r"\\\\uD[89A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]{2}(?!\\\\uD[C-Fc-f][0-9A-Fa-f]{2})", "\\\\uFFFD", s)
obj = json.loads(fixed)
```
(note: using `surrogatepass` to preserve escapes then rewrite them).

sam: good PoC. add guard: if replacement_count > 1 or if repaired length differs significantly, fail-fast and route original to manual review. don't silently fix heavy corruption.

ken: also run golden-funcall correctness check: sample 2k previously-successful prompts and compare action/arguments after repair vs before; if mismatch >0.25% pause auto-rescue.

marta: i'll add kernel CI fuzz test and coordinate with quant team on QNT-918. priya please add PoC to call-rescue with feature-flag and telemetry (`rescue=surrogate_*`).

priya: will push a draft PR today with feature-flag + mirror logging. target EOD for canary opt-in.

alex: i'll run a 12h soft-canary with repair flag on 10% hosts and post sanitized_parse_rate + retry_success metrics. also need a short audit to ensure we don't alter legal text or code blocks (high risk).

sam: for the audit, compare diffs limited to quoted strings only; fail if replacements inside code-fenced regions.

priya: noted. action items: priya PR, marta kernel CI, alex run soft-canary, ken add alert if `rescue_surrogate_rate` >3% for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
